cues: Commas decide what a relative clause means.
My brother who lives in Pokhara is a doctor, with no commas, is a defining clause: it tells you which brother, so I must have more than one.
My brother, comma, who lives in Pokhara, comma, is a doctor: a non defining clause, just extra information about a brother already identified, so I have only one.
And in a non defining clause, that is forbidden.
